name: Sinjaja Boroda
source:
Meet Denis, an ordinary teenager whose summer vacation has gone awry. Instead of sunny days, carefree relaxation, and dates, he has a “responsible” task ahead of him — to look after the sinister but seemingly empty mansion of the mysterious, absent owner whom everyone calls Bluebeard. Denis thought it would be a matter of dusting, watering flowers, and boredom in silence...

WELCOME TO MADNESS!

Bluebeard's mansion is not just a house, it is a living labyrinth of absurdity, black humor, and unimaginable dangers. As soon as Denis crosses the threshold, he realizes that he has entered a completely insane interactive fairy tale, where logic takes a break and old myths and urban legends come to life in the most unpredictable ways:

Talking Objects: From a creaky typewriter that keeps a diary of all the madness to a capricious teapot that demands only the finest teas, every object in the house may not be what it seems.

RESCUE AND SURVIVAL IN A MAD HOUSE:

But behind all these absurd wonders lies a real, deadly danger. Dennis quickly learns that his task is not just to watch over the house, but to understand its dark secrets and, most importantly, to save Bluebeard's last, mysterious wife, whose fate hangs in the balance. Will an ordinary teenager, armed only with common sense (for now), be able to extricate himself from this unimaginable story and, more importantly, save his own life from the madness that threatens to consume him?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3792300/]Steam[/url]]
